verdict.rationale: Codegen documents Slack integration where agents 'send notifications, ask for clarification, report progress' directly in team channels, plus Jira/Linear/Clickup/Monday.com status updates and comments, giving developers multiple channels to be notified of task completion or needed input. Missing for 10: no evidence of granular per-user notification preferences, mobile/email push alerts, or independent hands-on confirmation that notifications reliably fire on completion/input-needed events.
